Requirements:
The LinkedIn Learning and RiseUp integration involves the following requirements:

SectionPath: RiseUp Deep Integration Functionality
Blocks.Text:
An active RiseUp LMS instance
An active LinkedIn Learning account
Admin access to LinkedIn Learning
Admin privileges to your RiseUp LMS instance

SectionPath: Overview
Single Sign-On
Blocks.Text: During the initial configuration, you can configure LinkedIn Learning and your SSO provider to establish a secure SAML single sign-on (SSO) connection to ensure seamless access to content. SSO authentication reduces friction for users and administrators by eliminating the need for manual user registration. SSO ensures learners spend more of their time watching content and less of their time trying to remember usernames and passwords.

SectionPath: Overview
Automated Content Catalog Sync
Blocks.Text: The LinkedIn Learning library contains over 24,000 courses, with 20-30 courses added per week at no extra cost.

SectionPath: Overview
Automated Content Catalog Sync
Blocks.Text: RiseUp automates this process using the LinkedIn Learning content APIs, so LMS admins do not have to manually upload new content packages at regular intervals. After the initial setup, RiseUp will dynamically refresh the content library on an automated basis. This ensures new LinkedIn Learning content is available to learners within 24 hours of release. All content titles and descriptions are aggregated and indexed to accommodate keyword searches and support efficient discoverability.

SectionPath: Overview
Automated Content Catalog Sync
Blocks.Text: RiseUp supports automatic syncing of All languages content libraries.

SectionPath: Overview
Reporting
Blocks.Text: LinkedIn Learning captures all content viewed on its platform in robust usage reports accessible from the LinkedIn Learning administrative interface. In addition to generating reports, LinkedIn Learning uses xAPI to communicate a learner’s activity back to RiseUp when the learner completes a LinkedIn Learning course. All LinkedIn Learning course completions will be reported both in LinkedIn Learning and in RiseUp.

SectionPath: SSO Configuration
Blocks.Text: Enabling SAML SSO:

SectionPath: SSO Configuration
Blocks.Text:
LinkedIn Learning recommends SAML SSO for all enterprise learning platform integrations. SSO authentication can be configured in your LinkedIn Learning Admin settings. Most organizations have a centrally managed identity management solution like Azure AD, Okta or AD FS which can be configured to authenticate users into enterprise applications like LinkedIn Learning.

To configure SAML SSO with your identity management solution, share the LinkedIn Learning SSO Implementation Guide with your organization’s IT team.

Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
Blocks.Text: For RiseUp to sync LinkedIn Learning catalog metadata, API keys must be provisioned in LinkedIn Learning admin settings.

Blocks.Section: Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
Blocks.Text: To sync your RiseUp content with LinkedIn Learning, take the following steps:

Blocks.Section: Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
Blocks.Text:
Login to LinkedIn Learning. If you are not already in the Admin screen, select Go to Admin, then click Integration


From the side navigation menu, Access content and reports via API.

Click the down arrow on the right to expand the Generate LinkedIn Learning REST API Application section.


Click Add Application and provide the name related to your LMS (e.g., "RiseUp LMS Integration"), as the application name, and provide a short description of the integration use case in the application description field. For example, "RiseUp content catalog sync".





Under choose keys, there are two checkboxes – Content and Report. Select Content.

Click Next and accept the Terms and Conditions

Save the Client ID and Client Secret values.
